faq.q1: What is LogoDash and what is its main purpose?
faq.a1: LogoDash is a minimalist online logo generator designed specifically for indie developers, entrepreneurs, and content creators. Its core purpose is to help users with no design experience quickly create sleek, professional gradient-style logos optimized for both light and dark modes in minutes. It solves the pain point of 'delayed project launches due to lack of a suitable logo' in product development, empowering users to kickstart their projects faster.
faq.q2: How do I create a logo with LogoDash?
faq.a2: LogoDash offers two simple ways to create a logo: 1) Manual Creation: Select icons from the library, adjust stroke weight and margin ratios, add text, and customize backgrounds (gradient or solid color); 2) Random Generation: Click the random button to let the system generate a complete design automatically. Both methods support real-time preview, allowing you to craft professional logos without any design expertise.
faq.q3: What file formats does LogoDash support for export?
faq.a3: LogoDash supports exporting in two formats: SVG and PNG. SVG is a vector format that scales infinitely without losing quality, making it ideal for printing and high-resolution display scenarios. PNG is a raster format with a transparent background, perfect for websites and applications.
faq.q4: Where does LogoDash source its icons, and are they commercially usable?
faq.a4: LogoDash sources its icons from Lucide and Font Awesome. Both Lucide (under the ISC license) and Font Awesome (under the SIL OFL license) use open-source licenses that permit free commercial use. There are no copyright risks when using logos generated with LogoDash for personal or commercial projects.
faq.q5: How do logos generated with LogoDash adapt to dark mode?
faq.a5: This is a core design consideration for LogoDash. The tool’s signature gradient background style uses carefully curated bright colors and contrast ratios, ensuring logos remain clear, eye-catching, and visually polished not only on light backgrounds but also on dark mode taskbars, interfaces, or websites. It effectively avoids the issue of solid dark icons 'disappearing' against dark backgrounds.
